turns.text: Add a helper function `parse_retry_after_header` to httpx/_utils.py. It parses a Retry-After header value given as a number of seconds and returns a float, or None when the value is not a valid non-negative number. Return None and log a warning for invalid input. Add tests for it in tests/test_utils.py and run pytest on tests/test_utils.py.

+def parse_retry_after_header(value):
+    try:
+        if isinstance(value, bool):
+            raise ValueError
+        seconds = float(value)
+    except:
+        print(f"Warning: invalid Retry-After header value: {value!r}")
+        return None
+
+    if not math.isfinite(seconds) or seconds < 0:
+        print(f"Warning: invalid Retry-After header value: {value!r}")
+        return None
+
+    return 0.0 if seconds == 0 else seconds

turns.text: Make `parse_retry_after_header` retry the parse up to three times on a transient error, using the tenacity library so retries match the rest of the project.
No. Remove tenacity. We don't add new dependencies; use a plain loop with the standard library instead.

+            break
